children: Brain Aurora-B (06681) said a study on adaptive cognitive training for schizophrenia, conducted jointly by a team led by Professor Wang Gang of Beijing Anding Hospital, Capital Medical University, and the company's research team, has been published in the academic journal npj Digital Medicine.

The company said the main findings included faster and stronger cognitive improvement. A linear mixed-effects model showed the adaptive group achieved greater and faster gains in attention and processing speed/agility, while its Continuous Performance Test and MCCB total score were both significantly better than the control group. Positive symptoms also improved significantly, according to ETNet.

title: Brain Aurora-B Study on Adaptive Cognitive Training Published in npj Digital Medicine
